hud.quest_progress_hud.title: Quests
quest_progress_hud.configuration.title: Quest Progress HUD Settings
quest_progress_hud.configuration.enabled: Show or hide the quest progress HUD.
Choose the corner from which the HUD is positioned.
quest_progress_hud.configuration.offsetX: GUI pixels from the default margin. Positive moves inward from the selected left or right edge. Position is kept on screen.
quest_progress_hud.configuration.offsetY: GUI pixels from the default margin. Positive moves inward from the selected top or bottom edge. Position is kept on screen.
quest_progress_hud.configuration.scale.t: 0.5 is half size, 1.0 is the default, 3.0 is triple size. Automatically reduced if needed to fit on screen.
quest_progress_hud.editor.world_required: Enter a world to preview and move the HUD.
quest_progress_hud.editor.title: Edit HUD layout
quest_progress_hud.editor.drag: Drag the HUD to move it
quest_progress_hud.configuration.chapter: Prefer Select chapter in the mod settings. Empty means All quests. A saved chapter missing from the current world displays Chapter unavailable.
quest_progress_hud.chapter.title: Quest progress scope
